items.title: Manipal Hospitals scouts for acquisitions in Andhra, Keralam, Delhi-NCR; bets on AI-led healthcare
items.description: A key pillar of its upcoming infrastructure is the greenfield project in Juhu, Mumbai

items.title: SML Ltd weighing IPO within 2 to 3 years, eyes new chemical entity pipeline
items.description: The listing deliberations come as SML pushes deeper into three business lines beyond its traditional sulphur fertilizer base: crop nutrition, crop protection and biologicals

items.title: Why it’s getting harder for Tata Sons to resist an IPO
items.description: The latest RBI missive makes it even harder for the Tata family to hold out against a listing and the closer scrutiny of its affairs that this would entail

items.title: LIC may emerge top investor in anchor book of NSE IPO; ADIA, Carmignac may also bet big
items.description: The NSE IPO is set to open for public subscription on September 17 with a price band at Rs 1,700-1,785 per share. The offer will close on September 21

items.title: Monolithisch India bags quartzite stone block in Bihar for Rs 157 crore
items.description: This allotment will also accelerate the development of new products based on ore behaviour from a single, consistent supply source.

items.title: Coforge independent director DK Singh resigns amid board tensions, cites ‘differences’
items.description: The resignation comes after the company said Om Prakash Bhatt, who resigned as chairman earlier this week, had withheld from the board a finding that he received a low rating in a board evaluation report.

items.title: Audi India plots comeback with new models, EVs and 40-showroom network
items.description: Audi India is banking on a fresh product pipeline, a wider retail footprint and a renewed EV push to regain momentum in the luxury car market. The automaker is looking to double its market share to 16% over the next three-five years

items.title: Gadkari pitches digital ecosystem for ‘intelligent mobility’, bats for usage-based insurance
items.description: The government has drawing up a bill to impose stricter penalties for rash driving and traffic-rule violations, the minister said

items.title: Navi Mumbai airport struggles to attract international airlines; AERA widens tariff incentives
items.description: AERA has widened Navi Mumbai airport’s international tariff incentives as airlines remain cautious about starting operations from the new facility. The revised framework offers substantial landing-charge discounts to encourage new international passenger and cargo routes

items.title: Vedanta Aluminium, V-Spark announce deep tech partnerships worth Rs 2,100 crore
items.description: The collaborations will focus on improving plant productivity, cost optimisation, asset reliability and sustainability across Vedanta Aluminium’s operations.
